lan.intro: Once on, a phone or another computer on the same local network can scan to pair, then use VibeValley on this computer: see helpers, send work, talk in the farm chat.
lan.copied: Copied: open it in the other computer's browser.
lan.notCopied: Cannot copy: select the link and copy it yourself.
lan.scan: Scan this code with the phone's camera; on another computer, open this link in the browser:
lan.asking: "{name}" wants to connect to this computer. Let in, it can use VibeValley on this computer as you do.

notes.0: Helpers can run commands on this computer, so only paired devices may connect; pairing needs your approval here.
notes.1: A paired device uses VibeValley on this computer as you do. The switch and the devices are managed only on this computer.
notes.2: The connection is plain HTTP: people on the same network may see what goes over it. Turn it on only on networks you trust, such as your home Wi-Fi or your own hotspot.
notes.3: When the computer's address changes (another network), devices cannot connect; add the device here and scan again, without approving again.

pair.title: Connect to that computer
pair.intro: This device connects to VibeValley on that computer and, like the owner, sees helpers, sends work and talks in the farm chat. Pairing needs the owner's approval on that computer.
pair.codeHint: On that computer, press Add a device under Connect to this machine
pair.name: This device is called
pair.nameHint: The name the owner sees in the list of devices
pair.ask: Ask the owner to let it in
pair.waiting: Waiting for the owner on that computer to approve…
